summary: Trivial offset indexed dword read: returns the array element this[a2 + 3], i.e. a dword 3 elements (12 bytes) beyond the a2-selected element. No guards, globals, fields or callees. Called by ScoringGateSelector on the frame path; the LEGACY ABI lead names the 0xc displacement with element index 4.

local_names.this: base pointer of the caller's dword array
local_names.a2: dword index; the returned element sits at index a2 + 3

operations.description: Advance the element index by 3 dwords (a 12-byte byte displacement from this[a2]) to form this[a2 + 3].
Return the dword read from this[a2 + 3]; invoked by ScoringGateSelector as an offset gate/score lookup.

unresolved: What the 3-element offset (0xc displacement) selects relative to the a2 element is not evidenced by this packet; it depends on the unknown owning object's layout.
The owner class is unidentified; the LEGACY ABI lead names only the displacement and index pattern, not an object.
